# User settings image (store 50)

256 KB RAM image of the user settings, loaded whole at boot and saved whole at power-off.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0x623d1000` to `0x62411000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Stock records end well before the end; bytes in the unused tail are saved and restored too, and stock code never reads them. A block at +0x39f00 (0x6240af00) holds mod settings behind a 4-byte marker.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Boot load and save compare read from the store code. Source: [Saved mod settings and native menu rows on the E-M5 III](../sources/em5n.saved-settings.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Values written in the tail survive power-off. Source: [Saved mod settings and native menu rows on the E-M5 III](../sources/em5n.saved-settings.md).
